title: The Patek Philippe Museum celebrates 25 years
why: Hodinkee 'Dispatch: The Patek Philippe Museum Celebrates 25 Years'. Confirm facts on patekmuseum.com or patek.com. Photo: an official Patek/museum press image via photo.js press, else a library Patek photo.

sources.title: Dispatch: The Patek Philippe Museum Celebrates 25 Years

hard_gate_failures: Gate 2/4: the cover headline says 'Opens', but the opening date (CLM-3) is single-source and unverified, and Patek's page gives no date.
Gate 2: slide 4 (1989, Calibre 89, 'most complicated watch') has no claim of its own in research.json. Patek's page does support it, but it is tied to CLM-2, which does not cover it.
Gate 6: on slide 5 the photo credit sits at the top and overlaps the wordmark and @watchwireco handle.
Gate 6/soft: slide 5 reuses the cover photo and adds nothing new.
fixes: slide 1: change the headline to 'Patek Museum Turns 25' (no 'opens'). Alternatively, label the opening as reportedly and add it as a claim.

research.json: add a verified claim for Calibre 89, 1989 and 'most complicated watch in the world when unveiled', citing SRC-PATEK-QAQ. Point slide 4 at that claim. Make the slide 4 headline name 'Calibre 89' and cut the body to under 15 words.

slide 5: remove the slide, or move the photo credit to the bottom so it clears the wordmark and handle. A duplicate of the cover photo is weak, so removing it is preferred. A 5-slide post is acceptable only if the NEWS recipe allows it, which it does at 5 to 6 slides.
caption: keep the source line. Update it if the headline wording changes.
verdict.reason: The Patek facts are correct and the check passes. But the cover says the exhibition 'opens' when only one outlet gave a date, slide 4 isn't tied to a verified claim, and slide 5's credit overlaps the wordmark. Fix those and it can go out.
